prompt:
You are checking which candidate answer correctly answers a question about a SQL database.

Question:
Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?

4 candidates were produced independently. Each shows its SQL and the first rows of its result.

[A]
SQL:
WITH bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT 
        bb.bowler,
        COUNT(*) as wickets_taken
    FROM wicket_taken wt
    JOIN ball_by_ball bb ON wt.match_id = bb.match_id 
        AND wt.over_id = bb.over_id 
        AND wt.ball_id = bb.ball_id 
        AND wt.innings_no = bb.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
)
SELECT 
    br.bowler,
    p.player_name,
    br.runs_conceded,
    bw.wickets_taken,
    br.runs_conceded / bw.wickets_taken as bowling_average
FROM bowler_runs br
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
JOIN player p ON br.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 20

[B]
SQL:
WITH bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, 
           COALESCE(SUM(bs.runs_scored), 0) as runs_from_batsman,
           COALESCE(SUM(er.extra_runs), 0) as runs_from_extras
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    LEFT JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN extra_runs er ON bb.match_id = er.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = er.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = er.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = er.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
bowler_wickets AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id 
        AND bb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
)
SELECT br.bowler, 
       (br.runs_from_batsman + br.runs_from_extras) as total_runs,
       bw.wickets,
       ROUND((1.0 * (br.runs_from_batsman + br.runs_from_extras) / bw.wickets), 2) as bowling_average,
       p.player_name
FROM bowler_runs br
JOIN bowler_wickets bw ON br.bowler = bw.bowler
JOIN player p ON br.bowler = p.player_id
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 5

[C]
SQL:
WITH ball_runs AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.over_id, b.ball_id, b.innings_no, b.striker, b.non_striker, b.bowler, bs.runs_scored
    FROM ball_by_ball b
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON b.match_id = bs.match_id AND b.over_id = bs.over_id AND b.ball_id = bs.ball_id AND b.innings_no = bs.innings_no
),
player_runs_cum AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        over_id,
        ball_id,
        innings_no,
        striker,
        non_striker,
        bowler,
        runs_scored,
        SUM(runs_scored) OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no, striker ORDER BY over_id, ball_id) as cumulative_runs
    FROM ball_runs
),
wickets_with_runs AS (
    SELECT 
        w.match_id,
        w.over_id,
        w.ball_id,
        w.innings_no,
        w.player_out,
        pr.bowler,
        pr.cumulative_runs as runs_conceded
    FROM wicket_taken w
    JOIN player_runs_cum pr 
        ON w.match_id = pr.match_id 
        AND w.over_id = pr.over_id 
        AND w.ball_id = pr.ball_id 
        AND w.innings_no = pr.innings_no 
        AND (w.player_out = pr.striker OR w.player_out = pr.non_striker)
)
SELECT bowler, COUNT(*) as total_wickets, SUM(runs_conceded) as total_runs, 
       ROUND(SUM(runs_conceded) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as bowling_average
FROM wickets_with_runs
GROUP BY bowler
ORDER BY bowling_average ASC
LIMIT 5
